The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is characterized by a uniform brown color and a row of distinct eyespots (ocelli) with yellow rings and black centers along the hindwing margin. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green.

The connection points where the butterfly's legs touch the leaf are indistinct. The legs seem to merge into the leaf surface without clear shadowing or physical definition, a common AI artifact in complex occlusion areas.
